peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 4.1% below its local comparables; 62 of 130 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (31.4): 2.3 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 121 of 393 similar developments with a figure (the same as 5). Context, not scored: resales in 41.7% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 3-bedroom: median $3,100,000 ($2,213 psf, 1,323–1,743 sq ft; 6 resales, Jul 2024–Jun 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,308 psf (range $1,514–2,460); 4.1% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $133,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: King Albert Park MRT about 140 m, Beauty World MRT about 860 m; closer than 617 of 662 similar developments (the same as 8). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 3 within 2 km; nearest Methodist Girls' School (Primary) about 430 m; more than 292 of 662 similar developments (the same as 254). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 5 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 100 m), more than 177 of 662 similar developments (the same as 29); nearest hawker centre Bukit Timah Market about 770 m; nearest park Rail Corridor about 150 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Upcoming on the Cross Island Line: Maju MRT about 950 m (LTA target 2032) and Turf City MRT about 1,210 m (LTA target 2032), both under construction. Straight-line distances to the planned station sites; entrances are not yet published.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 4 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (The Reserve Residences, 2 new sales, about 690 m; 8@BT, 34 new sales, about 830 m; Amberwood at Holland, 24 new sales, about 1,110 m; Dunearn House, 237 new sales, about 1,240 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 76 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 297 new sales and 371 resales (668 purchases); new sales were 44.5% of these purchases. Subsales (44) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Holland Plain GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,070 m; Dunearn Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,120 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 371 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 80 of 662 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 371 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 410 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−9.5%). Planning-area private resales −4.6%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
